register.headline: Daniel reports a smaller n155 packing, started from Ostashev's packing
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its 17-group regularized view at the same side. The source reports a KKT local minimum strict modulo 31 exact flat motions, 96 corner-corner contacts with no corner-corner MILP descent and 4 rattlers, a different local minimum from T-149's packing with no load-bearing tilt angle shared; those are numerical evidence at 80 digits, as the source says, not proofs. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose basin explorer started from the register's witness for 155 (Daniil Ostashev's T-149 packing) and reached this packing after a chain of 18 moves, as the issue says; the issue asks that Ostashev's packing be credited as the start. The search, the checks and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code) under Evan Daniel's direction.
